_help: Drives the 'What We're Listening To' and 'Partner Ministries' sections on community.html. Admins: use the builder on admin-help.html to generate entries, then paste them into the right array below and commit. Each listening item supports one of these kinds: 'spotify' (type: 'episode' or 'show'), 'youtube', or 'link'. Partners just need name + url, with optional logo and description.
